your_games.title: 🏆 GTA VI is the biggest launch in PlayStation history, with 39 million PS5 players
your_games.body: Sony says more than 39 million unique players had played GTA VI on PS5 by 22 November, and it set a new record for concurrent players on PlayStation, beating every multiplayer, free-to-play and single-player game before it. Players logged 683 million hours between them, an average of 17.4 hours each over the opening days. It was also the first game played on 70% of newly connected PS5s.

your_games.title: 🩹 GTA VI's first patch fixes crashes, broken autosaves and story calls that don't trigger
your_games.body: Update 1.002.002 is about 600MB on PS5 and 1.6GB on Xbox Series X|S, and on PS5 it rolled out in waves through Monday. Rockstar's notes list fixes for several crashes, weather that stopped changing, autosaves failing, phone calls that blocked story missions, Wanted Levels that wouldn't clear, the gym deadlift bar and partners not handing over bags for fences. The notes don't name the CE-108255-1 PS5 error, so check whether it fixes yours.

your_games.title: ☁️ You can now stream GTA VI from the cloud on PS Plus Premium and Xbox
your_games.body: GTA VI has been updated to support PS Plus Premium cloud streaming to PS5 and PS Portal. It isn't in the Premium catalogue, so you still need to own it. Xbox Wire says the game also works with Xbox Cloud Gaming, including on Xbox One, using Series S settings, with select Game Pass plans getting up to 15 hours a month.

your_games.title: 🐉 RuneScape: Dragonwilds will put bug fixes before new content in 2027
your_games.body: Jagex says players have told it they want stability over a steady stream of content, so after December's Luminance update it will slow down on new quests, activities and features. Its priority order is bug fixes, then quality-of-life (Fishing, Farming and Construction tweaks, better chest navigation, storage at processing stations), then new content. A Player Test Realm is open by invitation, a public bug-voting board is planned, and fixes will be gathered into one stable release early next year.

your_games.title: ⚔️ Nioh 3's Bloody Insurrection DLC arrives on 17 December, and Xbox gets the game in January
your_games.body: The second DLC takes Takechiyo to Shimabara in 1638, with new martial arts for every weapon type and an endgame mode called the Battlefield of Carnage. If you own both DLCs and finish the third playthrough, a fourth playthrough with top-rarity Ethereal gear unlocks. A Complete Edition with the base game and both DLCs launches on 28 January 2027 for PS5, PC and, for the first time, Xbox Series X|S.

your_games.title: 🌊 Wave Race: Blue Storm joins the Switch 2 GameCube library, and you can now turn off the border
your_games.body: Wave Race: Blue Storm is now available for Switch Online + Expansion Pack members on Switch 2. Version 2.2.0 of the GameCube app also lets you switch off the border graphic under Extra Elements Display in a game's settings, though your profile icon stays on screen. So far the option is only in the GameCube app.

your_games.title: 🗡️ Final Fantasy VII Revelation gets its Switch 2 age rating, still due on 8 April
your_games.body: The ESRB has rated the last part of the Remake trilogy T for Teen on Switch 2, citing blood, language, mild suggestive themes and violence. That suggests the Switch 2 version is still on track to launch on the same day as the other versions.

your_games.title: 🌙 Pokémon GO teases its next season, Daydream Destinations
your_games.body: The first trailer shows Wishiwashi, Pyukumuku, Mega Drampa and Mega Froslass. The current season, Twilight Trails, ends on 1 December at 10:00 local time, and full event dates haven't been announced yet. Pokémon Champions players who did three or more battles in November's Monthly Challenge can also claim a Pawmot and 100 Quick Coupons.

industry.title: Plug In Digital buys indie publisher Twin Sails Interactive
industry.body: The two French companies are combining as the Plug In Digital Group, which also includes Dear Villagers, Celsius Online and porting studio PixelRatio. Twin Sails boss Nicolas Godement becomes group CEO and Plug In Digital founder Francis Ingrand moves to chairman. Twin Sails stays as a publishing label, and the group says indie developers now need bigger sales and distribution muscle to get noticed.

industry.title: Resident Evil creator Shinji Mikami says he wishes AI would vanish, but he still uses it
industry.body: Speaking with Shift Up CEO Kim Hyung-tae at G-STAR in South Korea, Mikami said he uses AI to preview his own 2D designs as 3D before a modeller builds them. He also said he worries developers could lose core jobs to AI within five to ten years. Kim said Shift Up no longer starts projects with AI after the backlash to its AI-generated Stellar Blade music video.

industry.title: An Activision patent describes NPCs that learn to trash-talk from players' voice chat
industry.body: The application, published on 12 November, describes capturing how players react around events like kills and wins, including on apps such as Discord and TeamSpeak, and training a neural network so NPCs react the same way. It mentions filters for offensive speech. As with any patent, it doesn't mean it will end up in a game.

industry.title: The Steam Awards turn 10 with a Hall of Fame vote for the past decade's best game
industry.body: Nominations are open until 30 November, with new categories such as Just Five More Minutes. The Hall of Fame pits the past ten winners against each other, from GTA V and The Witcher 3 to Elden Ring, Baldur's Gate 3 and Hollow Knight: Silksong. Final voting starts with the Steam Winter Sale on 17 December.
